Not present in complete form: (a) Theorem 1.2.5, third part, Q_II not<= Q_{1-1}: no proof (proofboundary def:p03-w03-p03-046-b-third, body 802-810); the source's route uses Shelah's computation of the Hanf number of (Th(=),Q_{1-1}) [Shelah 1973a,b], which is not held [blocked_source]; (b) the p.448 claims that Q_psi<=Q_phi implies (T,Q_psi)<=(T,Q_phi) for every theory T, that L_{omega omega}(Q_psi)<=L_{omega omega}(Q_phi) for every vocabulary and likewise for infinitary logics, and that interpretations in the sense of Definition 1.2.4 preserve Hanf number, are proved only for full-domain interpretations and interpretations in Q_I (thm:p03-w03-p03-046-b-transfer, b-hanf); the general case is stated as not settled (body 557-563, 607-616, 893-899) and must be proved, or its failure shown with an explicit counterexample and exact boundary [writable]; (c) the Section 1.1 claim (p.446) that in a vocabulary with only unary predicates the Feferman-Vaught theorem holds for monadic logic is not reconstructed [writable]; (d) the p.445 reported results of Isbell (a group-theory sentence true in S_kappa iff kappa=omega) and McKenzie [1971] (S_kappa == S_lambda implies kappa, lambda elementarily equivalent as ordered sets) are not reconstructed: McKenzie's result is not mentioned, Isbell's is mentioned and replaced by an own construction [blocked_source: Isbell, McKenzie 1971 not held].
